Reshape chromatograms

Source: R/reshape_chroms.R
reshape_chroms.Rd

Converts a list of chromatographic matrices into a single long-format data frame with one row per sample × retention time × wavelength combination.

Usage

reshape_chroms(
  x,
  idx,
  time_resolution = NULL,
  time_unit = NULL,
  sample_var = "sample",
  lambdas = NULL,
  rts = NULL,
  transfer_metadata = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A list of chromatographic matrices in wide format.

idx

Indices of chromatograms to convert. Defaults to all of them.

time_resolution

Desired temporal resolution, in minutes, regardless of the time unit of x, matching plot_chroms. Subsamples the time axis to approximately this interval. Defaults to NULL, which keeps the full resolution.

time_unit

Time units of the provided chromatograms: either "min", "s", or "ms". Used only to interpret time_resolution. Defaults to NULL, in which case the unit is taken from the time_unit attribute of the chromatograms, falling back to "min".

sample_var

Name of the new column containing sample identifiers.

lambdas

Wavelength(s) to include. Defaults to all wavelengths.

rts

Retention times to include, each matched to the nearest time point. Defaults to all retention times.

transfer_metadata

Logical. If TRUE, metadata attributes are transferred to the output. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A data frame in long format with columns rt, lambda, absorbance, and a sample identifier column specified by sample_var.

See also

Other utility functions: combine_peaks(), merge_peaks(), reshape_peaktable()

Author

Ethan Bass

Examples

data(Sa_warp)
reshape_chroms(Sa_warp, lambdas = 210)
